concept: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

prompt_en: A complex photographic scene holds one coherent moment with a fictional adult woman in a theater prop repair room just after the final curtain. The supplied image guides her visible face and hair appearance: a short dark bob, airy divided bangs, soft oval face, large dark almond eyes, small nose and full lips. Across a scarred worktable, she briefly looks up toward the photographer with a neutral, engaged expression while finishing a small repair. Her plain buttoned cotton work shirt is neatly fastened, with sleeves pushed back from the wrists. Both forearms rest lightly on the tabletop; her right fingertips rest on a domed red enamel paperweight seated fully on the curling corner of a hand-painted scenery plan, while her left palm spreads its opposite edge flat. A previously rolled portion still arcs upward behind the flattened corner. Curtain folds and rolled scenery lean against the distant wall, placing this ordinary repair task after a public performance. A chest-height three-quarter view from the opposite side shows her face, both connected arms, the paper and weight together; her face and working hands lead the frame. Render the entire picture in true grayscale except the single red enamel paperweight, which retains saturated crimson. The darkest hair and shelving tones sit at soft charcoal gray with readable strand and wood detail, while highlights roll smoothly. Local dodge-and-burn evens the larger cheek tones while fine pores and tiny natural skin variations remain clearly visible. Broad side window light shapes her face and the table; the background recedes gently while her eyes, cheeks and fingertips remain crisp.
